parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which the messages that you want to query belong.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The key of the messages that you want to query.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: The topic that contains the messages that you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons ons-message-get-by-key --topic test-mq_topic --key messageKey1 --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons OnsMessageGetByKey --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --Topic 'test-mq_topic' --Key messageKey1
